SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4771
Date 18/4/38

Summary re J. Sanchez, Spanish

In 1923 J. Sanchez Spanish, was one of the promoters
of the Great Northern Savings Society, No.224 Shantung Road
with a Sino-Spanish capital of $50,000.00, and later became
Managing Director of the company. Sometime later the
Society ceased to operate as a public savings society
confining itself to the insurance trade only. In 1926
L.K. Kentwell became President of the Society, and Sanchez
continued to act as Managing Director. Kentwell and
Sanchez entered into negotiations and took over the Compagnie
Orientile de Capitalisation, No.23 Avenue Edward VII, which
had an income of $43,000.00 per month derived from bonds issued.
Two months later Sanchez handed over control of the C.O.C.
and G.N.S.S. to a French Canadian George A de Fastree, and
left in April 1927 for Spain. Following his departure
suspicions arose regarding the financial status of the Society,
and it was discovered that the bond holders had been swindled
by Kentwell and Sanchez who got $200,000.00 each and A.C.
Mack $100,000.00 out of it.
Kentwell and Sanchez both having left Shanghai no
action was taken against them.

编号 D 4771
日期 1938年4月18日

关于西班牙人 J. Sanchez 的摘要

1923年，西班牙人 J. Sanchez 是山东路224号“大北储蓄会”（Great Northern Savings Society）的发起人之一，该会拥有中西合办资本50,000.00美元，他后来成为该公司的总经理。不久之后，该会停止作为公共储蓄机构运营，仅局限于保险业务。1926年，L.K. Kentwell 成为该会会长，Sanchez 继续担任总经理。Kentwell 和 Sanchez 进行谈判并接管了位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）23号的“东方资本化公司”（Compagnie Orientile de Capitalisation），该公司通过发行债券每月获得43,000.00美元的收入。两个月后，Sanchez 将东方资本化公司和大北储蓄会的控制权移交给法裔加拿大人 George A de Fastree，并于1927年4月离开前往西班牙。在他离开后，人们对该会的财务状况产生了怀疑，经查发现债券持有人遭到 Kentwell 和 Sanchez 的诈骗，二人各从中获利200,000.00美元，A.C. Mack 则获利100,000.00美元。
由于 Kentwell 和 Sanchez 均已离开上海，未对他们采取任何行动。
